items.title: US bill would stop chatbots acting human with kids
items.summary: Bipartisan House bill makes a non-personified mode the default for minors: no claimed feelings, guilt-tripping, or relationship-building to keep kids engaged.

items.title: Australia defends its under-16 social media ban in court
items.summary: Answering a High Court challenge, the government cites credible risks like addictive behaviour and disrupted sleep, while conceding scientific consensus is still lacking.

items.title: India’s Supreme Court questions children’s social media accounts
items.summary: Judges noted minors cannot legally sign contracts and asked the government to require an 18+ threshold or parental consent for platform accounts.
